subject.title: agent-core: parallel batch runs a prepared paid tool after the run is aborted mid-batch

question: Which open candidate PR should be treated as the canonical fix for this prepared parallel-tool abort race?
rationale: The issue is source-backed and two open PRs close it; one has sufficient real behavior proof while the other is a weaker duplicate, so a maintainer should choose the landing path rather than queue another fix.

options.title: Land the proof-sufficient candidate
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276, then close this issue and the duplicate candidate after merge.

options.title: Use the duplicate candidate instead
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102283 for comparable proof and intentionally choose that branch if maintainers prefer its patch shape.

options.title: Pause both PRs
options.body: Hold both candidates only if maintainers want a different cancellation architecture than a shared `executePreparedToolCall` guard.

recommendation.title: Land the proof-sufficient candidate
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276, then close this issue and the duplicate candidate after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current packaged agent-core loop history and are the strongest routing candidate for choosing the agent-core landing path.
